body:
Evidence-first review of PR #1 (riatzukiza/eros-eris-field, head 200ece03): all 9 full-diff pages read and assessed, covering all 11 changed files (851+/101-) — the pinned eta-mu evidence-review workflow, the byte-identical auto-merge → .disabled rename, two bounded .gitignore entries, append-only receipts/ledger, evidence JSONs, AGENTS.md, rewritten agent-workflows.md, and the new owning plan + ABI EDN.

Deterministic evidence: exact-head clean checkout; diff_stat, diff_hygiene and the pinned nbb ABI EDN parse all exited 0 with no errors. Verified against the unchanged tree: no license field/tracked license, external tsconfig path, graph-ant Math.random, eager-SQUASH caller content, all referenced workflow files present, agents-revision pin matches the mounted pack. Hand-checked the plan↔ABI agreement on quantum/substeps, xorshift, layer keys, safe-integer range, replay tolerances, statuses, exchange formula and the deflection worked example (math correct).

Confirmed finding (non-blocking, medium, 0.86): the plan's Proposed ABI section specifies restore-from-checkpoint validations (revisions, grants, seed counters, causal contributions), but the ABI EDN declares none — :checkpoint is one-way and no :functions entry accepts a snapshot/cursor — so the stated checkpoint-replay Outcome has no declared interface path; plan and ABI should be reconciled (declare a restore op or state explicitly that restore folds into admit-state).

Rejected candidate: an alleged read-recall trace-field mismatch (the plan's ABI bullet maps one-to-one onto the declared output).

Needs-human, non-blocking: whether the App private key is scoped away from the evidence-gate step that runs `npx --yes nbb@1.4.207` depends on the pinned external reusable workflow (45ec644c), which this review cannot inspect; verify key references are limited to the publishing step or swap the npx gate for the pinned toolchain.

Caveats: the PR body cites head b899d4bf… while the reviewed head is 200ece03… (stale body metadata, not a diff defect); source-manifest byte/SHA claims are author-verified and not re-derivable here; no tests/build are claimed or expected for this planning PR, and implementation RED/GREEN, licensing adoption and Rheos readiness remain explicitly open gates.
